# ChurchCRM Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), then load only the relevant card from
[the skill index](../.agents/skills/churchcrm/SKILL.md).
Follow [the AI operating model](../docs/contributing/ai-operating-model.md):
Copilot implements scoped assignments; CodeRabbit provides independent review.
Use the existing local validation and approval gates. Do not commit generated
captures or assume a task assignment authorizes an external write.
